period-life-table-2023.csv.what: SSA Actuarial Life Table: the 2023 period life table for the Social Security area population, as used in the 2026 Trustees Report. Columns per sex: death probability qx, number of lives lx (of 100,000 born), period life expectancy ex.
period-life-table-2023.csv.how: ssa.gov refuses plain HTTP clients (403), so the table was read from the rendered page in a browser and written row for row (ages 0-119, thousands separators removed). No values changed.

claiming-rules.json.what: Benefit as a percentage of PIA by claiming age for births 1960 and later (NRA 67), and the 2027 COLA (3.6%).
